A three-story '''office building''' was located in [[Xanas City]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Arms dealer/Legends|arms dealer]] [[Magresh (criminal)|Magresh]] operated out of the building until [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Noran Vran]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[656th regiment]] had it blown up in retaliation for him stealing medical supplies from the [[Regiment/Legends|regiment]] and forcing Vran to buy them back from him.<ref name="HR">{{WEGCite|book=Heroes & Rogues|story=A Pleasure Doing Business With You&hellip;}}</ref>
